title: The outage alarm checks about every 6 hours, not every 10 minutes
what: The alarm that should notice when the website, the gym panel, HQ or the gym server stops answering is set to run every 10 minutes, and the notes and the feature map say it does. In real life GitHub starts it only about 4 times a day: over 1 to 26 November the gap between checks was 6 hours in the middle case and almost 12 hours at worst. A gym panel outage in the evening rush can last hours before anyone is told.
expected: Each part is checked every few minutes, as promised, so an outage is reported within minutes.
fix_line: Move the check to a timer that really runs every few minutes (the HQ server's every-minute timer or a free uptime service) and keep GitHub only as a backup

title: The real-phone robot check has never run after a release
what: The set-up guide says Google's robot taps through every release on 5 real phones. In real life the check has run once ever, by hand on 18 October, and that run stopped at 'not set up yet'. It has not started after any of the releases since, because it waits for the release run to finish, and that kind of start never fires after a version tag (the release run's own notes say so about the Play upload, which was moved for that reason in October). So nobody gets the crash and broken-screen report the notes describe.
expected: After each release the robot check starts by itself, or the notes say plainly that it is off.
fix_line: Start the robot check from inside the release run, as was done for the Play upload, and check its two keys exist

title: Two cloud runs on main are missing from the feature map
what: The iPhone upload to Apple's test app (a draft, never run) and the WhatsApp test reply (added 25 November, never run) are switched on in GitHub and can be started by hand, but the feature map does not list them, so the live-state page cannot show them.
expected: Every cloud run on main has a line in the feature map with its state.
fix_line: Add both runs to the feature map

title: Version 0.80.0 went to Play testers without the phone conditions test
what: The phone conditions test (update from the last version, no internet, flaky link, app killed, battery saver, alarms denied) ran for 0.79.0 but has not run since 17 November. The 0.80.0 release run passed on 26 November and sent 0.80.0 to Play's testing tracks with no conditions run on it. The release does not wait for this test, so nothing stopped it.
expected: Every version sent to Play testers has a passing conditions run, as the upgrade and interruption checks need.
fix_line: Run the conditions test on each release candidate and have the release check it passed
